选定行动，明确交付；遇到阻塞先处理，做过的结果继续保留。: Choose an action and its deliverable. Resolve blockers first and keep the results.
已超出预算，请先调整: Over budget. Adjust the plan first.
先核对预算，再创建行动: Check the budget before creating an action.
把一个疑问，写成可开始的小行动: Turn a question into a small action
只安排这一次要回答的问题和产物。提交后先检查范围与预算。: Define the question and deliverable for this attempt. Check scope and budget before starting.
这次想弄清什么？: What do you want to find out?
例如：我是否能解释一份数据中的异常？: For example: Can I explain an anomaly in a dataset?
例如：问题清单、处理说明与局限: For example: questions, process notes and limitations
你有一份未开始的预检草稿：: An unstarted scope draft is available:
先看看原创实践的任务与产物，再决定是否投入。: Explore practice tasks and deliverables before committing time.
补录实际发生的过程与结果，不补造事前安排。: Record what actually happened, without inventing a prior plan.
回到这里查看记录，再用一次复盘决定下次怎样调整。: Revisit your record here and review what to change next time.
这项行动不在当前筛选中或已不可访问。: This action is outside the filter or no longer available.
需要先处理阻塞或依赖: Resolve a blocker or dependency first
这个状态暂时没有行动，已有记录仍然保留。: No actions in this state. Existing records are retained.
前置任务尚未完成，暂时不能直接开始。: A prerequisite task is incomplete. Complete it before starting.
还没有受阻原因记录，可到详情中补充。: No blocker reason recorded. Add one in the details.
还没有提交产物或保存行动结果。先完成这一小步，再记录发生了什么。: No artifact or result saved yet. Take this small step, then record what happened.
把这次行动接到下一次: Connect this attempt to the next
不必等全部完成，实际发生的尝试也可以复盘。: You can review a real attempt before the whole task is complete.
从队列选择一项行动: Select an action from the queue
这里会显示它的交付、已有记录与下一步。: Its deliverable, saved records and next step appear here.
把一次经历，变成下一次的具体做法: Turn an experience into your next approach
先还原事实，再解释原因，最后只确定一个准备尝试的调整。: Start with facts, explore causes, then choose one change to try.
先有一次行动，再谈如何调整: Start with an action to review
复盘需要关联实际行动。做过课程项目、自主学习或一次调研，都可以从真实记录开始。: Connect a review to an actual action: a course project, self-directed learning or research.
一份有用的复盘，会留下这三件事: A useful review leaves three things
无需填满大段表格。选定行动后，可以逐步记录，草稿会按行动分别保留。: Choose an action and write in stages. Each action keeps its own draft.
每项行动单独保留草稿，不混用结果与反馈。: Each action keeps a separate draft and feedback.
关联行动已不可访问，请重新选择；不会显示其他行动的草稿代替。: This action is unavailable. Choose another action; its draft will remain separate.
记录已保留。是否调整计划，由你在预览后决定。: Your record is saved. Preview any plan change before deciding.
这一次，我学到了什么？: What did I learn this time?
做了什么，留下了什么；其中哪些是自己负责的？: What did you do and produce? Which part was your own contribution?
记录原话或具体观察，没有收到就留空。: Record specific feedback or observations. Leave blank if none.
是哪一步、哪种条件影响了结果？区分观察与猜测。: Which step or condition affected the result? Separate observation from guesses.
下一次准备改变什么做法，用什么产物或反馈观察效果？: What will you change next time? How will you observe its effect?
草稿自动保存在本机；保存后可修订，不自动改变任务状态、能力或主目标。: Drafts save on this device. Saved reviews can be revised; task status, ability and main goal do not change automatically.
引用这段记录到结果草稿: Copy this record into result draft
这项行动尚无保存的结果；请按本次实际发生的过程填写。: No result has been saved for this action. Describe what actually happened.
仅在本机整理本人记录。私人反思默认不进入报告正文，调整计划需要另行预览。: Personal records stay on this device. Private reflections are excluded from report text by default. Plan changes require a separate preview.
回看之前，下一次才有变化: Revisit past attempts to improve the next
保留当时的结果与调整，修订会留下原版本。: Keep the results and proposed changes. Revisions retain the original version.
当前行动还没有复盘，可切换全部记录查看。: No reviews for this action. Switch to all reviews to see other records.
还没有保存复盘。完成一次尝试后，把结果与下一做法留下来。: No saved reviews yet. After an attempt, record the result and your next approach.
本人复盘已保存；任务、目标和计划没有自动改变。: Review saved. Task, goal and plan were not changed automatically.
请补充实际结果、困难原因和下一调整，再保存复盘。: Add the result, causes and next change before saving.
关联行动已不可用，请重新选择。: The linked action is unavailable. Choose another.
请选择已有的活动类型。: Choose one of the available activity types.
查看当前选中行动的交付、已有记录与下一步；开始或恢复仍需核对依赖和预算。: View the selected action, records and next step. Starting or resuming still checks dependencies and budget.
当前筛选或引用没有可选行动，可返回全部行动重新选择。: No action matches this filter or link. Return to all actions to choose again.
回看这一次，给下次一个新办法: Look back once. Find a new approach for next time.
从一个在意的瞬间开始，留下一个准备尝试的具体做法。: Start with a moment that matters. Leave one specific approach to try next time.
顺利、卡住、被提醒，都有值得回看的地方。: A useful step, an obstacle or some feedback can all be worth exploring.
只读示例，不会写入本人记录: Read-only example. Never added to your records.
练习前，我先列出了需要检查的字段，后面可以逐项核对。: Before the exercise, I listed the fields to check so I could review them one by one.
清单可能帮我少漏步骤，但还没对照另一种做法。: The list may have helped me miss fewer steps, but I have not compared it with another approach.
下次开始前先列检查清单，完成后再看有没有遗漏。: Next time, make a checklist before starting and check for omissions afterwards.
我直接开始做图，后来发现字段含义没有弄清，只能返工。: I started making the chart before understanding the fields, so I had to redo it.
开始前没有核对字段说明；其他影响还不确定。: I had not checked the field descriptions first. Other factors are still uncertain.
下次先写出字段含义和疑问，核对后再开始做图。: Next time, write down field meanings and questions, check them, then make the chart.
展示作品后，对方说“看不出这张图想回答什么”。: After I showed the work, someone said, “I cannot tell what question this chart answers.”
我没有说明图表要回答的问题；是否还有其他原因，需要再问。: I had not explained the question the chart addressed. I need to ask about any other reasons.
下次先说明问题和图表用途，再请对方看看是否清楚。: Next time, explain the question and the chart purpose, then ask whether they are clear.
换成你自己的这一次: Now start with your own attempt
做过一份作业、一次练习或一场交流，都可以从真实记录开始。: Start with an actual assignment, exercise or conversation you took part in.
这次想从哪里开始想？: Where would you like to start?
这次哪一步做得顺，留下了什么？: Which step worked well, and what did it leave?
哪个做法帮到了你？还有什么没核对？: Which approach helped? What still needs checking?
下一次，你想保留哪一个好办法？: Which useful approach would you keep next time?
找一个具体片段，写清自己的行动和实际结果。: Choose a specific moment. Describe your own action and what actually happened.
从方法、材料或配合说起；暂时的解释可以保留为猜测。: Think about methods, materials or collaboration. Keep tentative explanations as guesses.
写清在什么情况下再用这个办法，以及怎样观察它是否有用。: Say when you would use this approach again and how you would observe whether it helps.
这次卡在哪一步，当时实际发生了什么？: Where did you get stuck, and what actually happened?
哪种条件影响了这一步？哪些还只是猜测？: What affected this step? Which explanations are still guesses?
如果再遇到这个卡点，你准备先改哪一步？: If you meet this obstacle again, what would you change first?
可以写没做完的地方。先还原过程，不急着评价自己。: Unfinished work counts too. Reconstruct what happened before judging yourself.
看看输入、方法、范围或协作，找一个具体影响因素。: Consider inputs, methods, scope or collaboration. Look for a specific factor.
把调整缩小成一次可尝试的做法，效果仍需下一次观察。: Make the change small enough to try once. Its effect still needs observing.
对方具体说了什么？当时展示了什么？: What exactly did the other person say? What did you show?
反馈对应哪一处？你的理解还需要确认吗？: Which part does the feedback concern? Does your interpretation need checking?
你准备先回应哪条反馈，怎样再检查一次？: Which feedback would you address first, and how would you check again?
在反馈栏保留明确原话，没有收到的部分留空。: Keep explicit words in the feedback field. Leave unreceived feedback blank.
把对方的反馈与你自己的解释分开，不替对方猜测。: Separate their feedback from your interpretation. Do not guess for them.
选择一条能着手处理的反馈，写出具体尝试。: Choose one piece of feedback you can address and describe a specific attempt.
只参考组织方式，不会填入你的复盘。: Use the structure as a reference. It will not be inserted into your review.
把发现带到下一次: Take one insight into the next attempt
本人草稿 · 尚未应用到计划: Your draft · not applied to the plan
这里会留下你准备尝试的做法。先改一小步，也可以。: Your next approach will appear here. A small change is enough to begin.
回看之前，给下次留一条线索: Keep a clue for the next attempt
